adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a PUT route (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`) and an Ember controller action `saveChanges()` that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs` contains no button or action wiring that would trigger `saveChanges`. The actual persistence in the UI is per-host via `embeddable-host` component calling `host.save(props)` and `destroyRecord()`, so the embedding-level update endpoint/action appears unused/dead in this diff. Likewise, `admin.embedding.edit` is added in `client.en.yml` but not referenced anywhere in the shown templates/components. This is traceable as unused surface, but it doesn't demonstrably break functionality given per-host save/delete exists.
